svg.title: The groups of keys on a computer keyboard
svg.desc: A simplified keyboard. Function keys F1 to F12 run along the top. The alphanumeric keys (letters, numbers and symbols) are in the main block, with the Space bar. Modifier and special keys such as Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Tab, Caps Lock, Enter and Backspace are at the edges of the main block. The cursor (arrow) keys and editing keys such as Insert, Delete, Home and End are to the right. The numeric keypad is on the far right.
